seo.title: Stretch Easy — Guided Stretching Routines for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: Short, guided stretching routines with a timer for every stretch and a cue to switch. Keep a daily streak, save to Apple Health if you like, and follow along on Apple Watch. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: GUIDED STRETCHING
hero.title: A few minutes of stretching, every day.
text: Today's routine is waiting when you open the app. Tap Start and follow along: a timer for every stretch, how to do it, and a cue when it's time to switch. Ink on paper, with color only for your streak.

items.title: Today's Routine
items.text: Morning Wake-Up before 11, Desk Break through the day, Evening Wind-Down at night. The right routine is one tap from the moment you open the app.

items.title: Five Ready-Made Routines
items.text: Morning Wake-Up, Desk Break, Post-Workout, Full Body and Evening Wind-Down, from 3 to 16 minutes.

items.title: Follow Along
items.text: A ring counts down each stretch with how to do it underneath, short rests in between, and a haptic and sound cue when it's time to switch. The screen stays on.

items.title: Your Own Routines
items.text: Pick from 16 stretches and set each one's time and the rest between them. Or choose the areas that feel tight and get a routine for them.

items.title: A Streak Worth Keeping
items.text: See whether you've stretched today and how many days in a row. History shows your personal best and sixteen weeks at a glance.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Turn it on and each routine you finish is saved to Apple Health as a Flexibility workout. Stretch Easy only writes workouts and never reads your health data.

items.title: All Five Routines
items.text: Pick a routine on your Apple Watch and follow along on its own, no iPhone needed.

items.title: A Tap to Switch
items.text: A tap on your wrist for each new stretch and the last seconds counted down, even with your wrist down.

items.title: Your Accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents to mark your streak. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions.

items.title: Day or Night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

items.title: Your Cues
items.text: Separate switches for sounds, haptics, countdown sounds and auto-advance.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your data stays yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No accounts. No cloud sync. Your routines and history stay on your device, and Apple Health gets workouts only if you turn it on.

cta.title: Start stretching.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
